title: Shifted quantum affine superalgebras
summary: For a quantum affine superalgebra with a fixed Drinfeld current presentation, we study shifted quantum affine superalgebras through a two-sided shifted Drinfeld current presentation, in which the leading degrees of the Cartan--Drinfeld currents are modified while the remaining current and Serre relations are retained. We then focus on the standard-parity type A algebras $\mathcal U_q^{μ_+,μ_-}(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_{m|n})$. For arbitrary shifts and $m,n\ge1$, $m\ne n$, we prove a triangular decomposition.
